entries.name: Generalized Stirling numbers, [n+8,8]_5.
a(n) = |{0 < k < n: L(k) + q(n-k) is prime}|, where L(k) is the k-th Lucas number (A000204), and q(.) is the strict partition function (A000009).
a(n) = s(1)t(n) + s(2)t(n-1) + ... + s(k)t(n-k+1), where k = [ n/2 ], s = (Lucas numbers), t = (odd natural numbers).
a(n) = T(n,n+1), where T is the array defined in A025564.

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(2*n-1)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n, s(0) = 2, s(2*n-1) = 7. Also a(n) = T(2*n-1,n-3), where T is the array defined in A026009.

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(2*n-1)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n, s(0) = 3, s(2*n-1) = 4. Also a(n) = T(2*n-1,n-1), where T is defined in A026022.

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(2*n-1)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n, s(0) = 3, s(2*n-1) = 6. Also a(n) = T(2*n-1,n-2), where T is defined in A026022.

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(2*n-1)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n, s(0) = 2, s(2*n-1) = 5. Also a(n) = T(2*n-1,n-2), where T is the array defined in A026009.

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(n)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n and s(0) = 3. Also a(n) = Sum{T(n,k), k = 0,1,...,[ (n+3)/2 ]}, where T is defined in A026022.
a(n) is the number of binary words containing n 1's and at most n 0's that do not contain the substring 101.

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(2n)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n, s(0) = 2, s(2n) = 4. Also a(n) = T(2n,n-1), where T is the array defined in A026009.
a(0) = 1; for n > 0, a(n) = binomial(n, floor(n/2)) + binomial(n-1, floor(n/2)).
a(n) is the maximum number of heptiamonds in a hexagon of order n.
Expansion of g.f. A(x) satisfying A(x) = 1 + 2*x*A(x)^2 - x*A(-x)^2.
Expansion of (1/(1-x)^2)*c(x/(1-x)^4) where c(x) is the g.f. of A000108.
a(n) = lcm_{p is prime and divisor of n} p-1.

a(0) = 1, and for n >= 1, a(n) is either the largest divisor of a(n-1) not already present in the sequence, or (if all divisors already used), a(n-1) * {the least prime p such that p does not divide a(n-1) and p*a(n-1) is not already present}.
Dirichlet g.f.: Sum_{n>0} a(n)/n^s = (zeta(s)*zeta(6*s))/(zeta(2*s)*zeta(3*s)).
Expansion of g.f. A(x) = Sum_{n=-oo..+oo} x^n * (i + x^n)^(2*n), where i^2 = -1.
Expansion of g.f. A(x) = Sum_{n=-oo..+oo} x^n * (2 + x^n)^(2*n).
Expansion of g.f. A(x) = Sum_{n=-oo..+oo} x^n * (3 + x^n)^(2*n).
a(n) = 1 if the divisors of n increase by a factor of at most 2, otherwise 0.
entries.text: a(n) <= A322860(n). [Conjectured, see comment in A174973]

entries.name: a(n) is smallest divisor d of the n-th primorial such that d + prime(n)#/d is prime.
a(n) is the greatest common divisor of all the numbers in row n of Pascal's triangle excluding 1 and n.
a(n) = sigma_n(n): sum of n-th powers of divisors of n.
entries.text: Conjecture: 5 is the only prime in this sequence. - _Rayhan Ahmed_, Jun 19 2026

entries.name: No position of a 1 in the reversed binary expansion of n is a power of 2.

Szekeres's sequence: a(n)-1 in ternary = n-1 in binary; also: a(1) = 1, a(2) = 2, and thereafter a(n) is smallest number k which avoids any 3-term arithmetic progression in a(1), a(2), ..., a(n-1), k.
a(n) = |{0 < k < n: 2^k - 1 + q(n-k) is prime}|, where q(.) is the strict partition function (A000009).

a(n) = |{0 < k < n: m = phi(k)/2 + phi(n-k)/8 is an integer with p(m)^2 + q(m)^2 prime}|, where phi(.) is Euler's totient, p(.) is the partition function (A000041) and q(.) is the strict partition function (A000009).
Number of partitions of n into an odd number of parts, the greatest being 3; also, a(n+5) = number of partitions of n+2 into an even number of parts, each <= 3.
Number of partitions of n into an even number of parts, the greatest being 3; also, a(n+5) = number of partitions of n+2 into an odd number of parts, each <= 3.
a(n) is the number of set partitions of {0, ..., n} in which, for every part P, the sum of binomial(n, k) over k in P is a power of 2.
Alternating row sums of triangle A291844.
entries.text: Conjecture: D-finite with recurrence n*a(n) +(-3*n+1)*a(n-1) +2*(-n+3)*a(n-2) +2*(n-5)*a(n-3) +(n-4)*a(n-4) +(n-5)*a(n-5)=0. - _R. J. Mathar_, Jun 17 2020

entries.name: a(1)=2, a(2)=3, for n>=3, a(n) is the n-th number which is obtained by application of Eratosthenes-like sieve (with removing 1's) to sequence: odd part of digit sum of 2^m, m>=1.
